motions.verifierNote: REFUTED (issue). The clause permits home occupations to produce low-risk home-prepared foods and employ up to three non-resident staff — this is home-based-business/commercial-licensing regulation, not a housing-supply, density, or dwelling-type question. The housing/use-permission axis in direction-rules.ts is built around dwelling types (ADU, secondary suite, triplex, townhouse, laneway house) — a home food-business employment rule doesn't fit that concept even loosely; only the itemTitle's Z-25103 structural code triggers the housing classification here, over content that isn't really about housing at all. Downstream, tagging this a 'housing/restrictive' position for the unanimous nays would misrepresent what they voted against (permitting home food businesses to hire staff, not permitting more homes). Since the vote was unanimous (0-5), no comparative signal is lost by downgrading. axis/polarity set to null; issue left as housing per the documented code-pattern precedent but this entry should be treated as a genuine edge case in that rule.
